system.description:
Ancient draconic blood runs through your line: distant, potent, and hungry for power. It runs in Depsopteron's dragon hierarchy, the dragonborn camps of Komodo Isle and lines from the Never-ending War.

  • Bloodline Cantrips: Endure Elements and Resistance.
  • Bloodline Ability (1st): Choose one damage type tied to a dragon colour (fire, cold, lightning, acid, or poison).
  • Gain Resistance 5 to that type.
  • Your AC increases by 1 permanently as scales occasionally emerge under your skin.
  • You speak and understand Draconic and have Advantage on Charisma checks to awe or intimidate a creature of lower Level than you.
  • Bloodline Awakening (10th): Once per day, unleash your ancestor's aura until the encounter ends (1 minute outside one): each enemy that starts its turn within 30ft of you makes a Will save or is Frightened of you until the aura ends; a creature that saves is immune to the aura for the rest of the aura. Your chosen damage type ignores resistance while it lasts.
